proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ A B C D X Y Z hAB hCD hXYZ h1 h2 h3 h4
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (by rw [Fact.out (p := Module.finrank ℝ V = 3)]; norm_num)
  set W : Submodule ℝ V := vectorSpan ℝ ({X, Y, Z} : Set P) with hW
  have hind : AffineIndependent ℝ ![X, Y, Z] := affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_set.mpr hXYZ
  have hfr : Module.finrank ℝ W = 2 := by
    have := hind.finrank_vectorSpan (n := 2) (by simp)
    rwa [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty, Set.union_empty, Set.singleton_union, Set.singleton_union] at this
  have hsum := Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal W
  have hfr2 : Module.finrank ℝ Wᗮ = 1 := by
    rw [hfr, Fact.out (p := Module.finrank ℝ V = 3)] at hsum
    omega
  have mem : ∀ v : V, inner ℝ v (Y -ᵥ X) = 0 → inner ℝ v (Z -ᵥ X) = 0 → v ∈ Wᗮ := by
    intro v h5 h6
    rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal']
    intro w hw
    rw [hW, vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right ℝ (show X ∈ ({X, Y, Z} : Set P) by simp)] at hw
    induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · simp
      · exact h5
      · exact h6
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [inner_add_right, hx, hy, add_zero]
    | smul a x _ hx => rw [real_inner_smul_right, hx, mul_zero]
  have hu0 : (⟨B -ᵥ A, mem _ h1 h2⟩ : Wᗮ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; exact hAB (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp (congrArg Subtype.val h)).symm
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' _ hu0).mp hfr2 ⟨D -ᵥ C, mem _ h3 h4⟩
  have hc' : c • (B -ᵥ A) = D -ᵥ C := congrArg Subtype.val hc
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_smul] at hc'
    exact hCD (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp hc'.symm).symm
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev, ← hc']
  exact (Submodule.span_singleton_smul_eq (IsUnit.mk0 _ hc0) _).symm
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 3)] (A B C D X Y Z : P), A ≠ B → C ≠ D → ¬Collinear ℝ ({X, Y, Z} : Set P) → inner ℝ (B -ᵥ A) (Y -ᵥ X) = 0 → inner ℝ (B -ᵥ A) (Z -ᵥ X) = 0 → inner ℝ (D -ᵥ C) (Y -ᵥ X) = 0 → inner ℝ (D -ᵥ C) (Z -ᵥ X) = 0 → (line[ℝ, A, B]).Parallel line[ℝ, C, D]
